svg.title: Running 1.2 billion LFI sandboxes on 10GB RAM

cc:Work.dc:title: Running 1.2 billion LFI sandboxes on 10GB RAM
cc:Work.dc:description: 427 original samples; first print by 3.259433279s, completion observed at 291.005461237s; 1,262,500,000 printed sandboxes; 10,119,827,456 accounted bytes. Memory is in decimal GB. Zoom shows the first six seconds. Both scales are linear.
